seed_derivation: int.from_bytes(sha256('ic-detection-boundary-v4-inference-docking-<case>').digest()[:8], 'big'), except where the project hard-codes a seed that defines its stream (stop rule: 250925006), which is shared

1_profile_solver.adapter: target = zeros(M=1024, 2); evaluate(phi, eta) = docking diffs(phi, eta), so project differences == docking diffs bytewise; eta box [0, 0.8]; identity=True iff an anchor is given
1_profile_solver.noise: exact zero-mean alternating +/-0.02 rows, unless stated

cases.S02_smooth_nonlinear_interior: tanh L1, bilinear L2, root phi=0.55 eta=0.3
cases.S12_nan_region: NaN rows when phi > 0.7, else S01
cases.S15_anchor_mean_zero_not_bytewise: S01-like linear with root at the anchor, identity family
cases.S21_near_threshold_endpoint: one-param L1 = phi - 0.999 + 0.999*tol-sized offset at the upper endpoint

criteria.accepted_residuals: for accepted statuses both implementations satisfy |gbar_k| <= tol_k on every fitted moment (checked on each side independently)
criteria.parameters: for accepted statuses with an equal status: |dphi|, |deta| <= 1e-3. Roots are defined only up to the acceptance tolerance, and the search paths legitimately differ (warm start, inexact inner solves), so the 1e-12 criterion does not apply

2_acceptance_tolerance.project: profile_match inner `at` (tolerance field of ProfileFit) and ProfileFit.se
2_acceptance_tolerance.cases: every ProfileFit returned in component 1, plus a one-parameter probe per SE value in {0, 1e-7, 4e-6 (floor kink), 1e-5, 2e-4 (cap kink), 1e-3}

3_validation.project: validate_fit; fit_cell (retry orchestration, via a stub PanelSource on a non-observed channel)

cases.V08_random: 20 random Gaussian draws with residual 0..6 combined SE
cases.R03_solver_gap_no_retry: solver returns a gap in attempt 0

criteria.equivalence_passed: exact equality (project: all fitted moments; docking reports per moment, reduced with all())
criteria.retry: exact equality of the attempt count, the M sequence and the final success

cases.N01_project_shift_random: 500 random residuals, 20 random well-conditioned J (J00>0, Schur>0), points interior / eta=0 / eta=0.8 / phi near 0 and 0.999
cases.N03_fd_jacobian: smooth nonlinear mean map at points interior, phi=0.995 (inward), eta=0.795 (inward), steps 0.01 and 0.005
cases.N04_nuisance_draws_interior: M=64, 20 networks/class, 3 features, draws=200, theta=(0.6,0.3); indices reproduced from the project's documented stream (SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3)); AUC by the project's discriminator (A12)
cases.N05_nuisance_draws_face: as N04 with theta=(0.6,0.0) and residual pushing eta below 0 (projection active)

criteria.auc_draws: default continuous tolerance (identical indices and discriminator)
criteria.mcse: reported; formula differences are classified, not tolerated

cases.B01_gaussian_icc05: 200 networks x 2 events x 9 slots, B=300
cases.B06_production_size_distribution: 2000 networks, B=2000, one slot: SE_scores of both vs Monte Carlo SD over independent datasets (distributional, margin 15%)

5_cluster_bootstrap.shared_stream: rng = default_rng(seed); per draw: null indices integers(n0, n0), then social indices integers(n1, n1), as the project documents its stream; the docking side receives these indices

criteria.se_total: default continuous tolerance with the same V_nuis

cases.G01_band_random: 10 random Uncertainty-equivalent inputs; compare critical and bands
cases.G02_band_floor_degenerate: zero SE, constant replicates: critical >= 2.7729 on both
cases.C10_sustained_across_gap: all AUC >= 0.70 from a=0.01 with a gap at a=0.03 (A18)
cases.C11_crossing_at_a0_valid_gate: AUC at a=0 is 0.72 with band containing 0.5

6_band_gap_gate.band_inputs_for_C_cases: for the gap and censoring rules, both sides receive identical lower/upper arrays (the project's band output on the available slots), so only the rules are compared

criteria.censoring_reason_presence: exact equality of whether an end is censored by a gap

cases.A01_g2_patterns: per-cell failure patterns at and around 5/100 and ceil(0.02*pipelines)

classification.a: spec ambiguity (reading differs; both defensible under the spec text)
classification.b: docking bug (fixed in the docking code, recorded)
classification.c: probable project mismatch (file:line, spec quote, minimal reproducer)
